# Pratik Mehta

> Technical Lead, Adobe Commerce Architect, and AI-Enabled Developer with 10+ years architecting enterprise eCommerce platforms and shipping agentic AI workflows in production. Based in Pune, India — open to remote and relocation.

## Summary

Pratik Mehta is a Technical Lead with 10+ years of experience architecting enterprise eCommerce platforms across 15+ international projects, including Minii Hypermarket, NASM, T-Mobile, FJ Jewelry, Perfecta BE, and Amrutanjan. He is an Adobe Commerce (Magento 2) specialist who delivers measurable performance gains through advanced system design, Redis/Varnish caching, and API engineering. He is Anthropic Claude Code 101 certified and actively ships custom MCP servers, RAG pipelines, and agentic AI workflows in production. He is a proven cross-functional leader in Agile, cross-timezone, multi-million-dollar engagements, currently seeking senior Technical Lead or eCommerce Architect roles in platform engineering or AI-augmented development.

## Current Role

**Technical Lead | Adobe Commerce Expert** at NeoSOFT Technologies (CMMi Level 5), Pune, India — Sep 2020 to Present.

- Leading the Minii Hypermarket project (2024–Present): a mobile application and REST/GraphQL APIs on Magento 2.4.8-p3 for Mongolia's national retail chain — 72 stores, 9,000+ SKUs, bilingual (Mongolian + English), with event-driven ERP sync via RabbitMQ achieving 99.9% ERP–Magento data accuracy.
- Delivered NASM & T-Mobile headless storefronts (2021–2022) using API Mesh, App Builder AIO actions, and Commerce Starter Kit GraphQL APIs across US and European markets.
- Built a production Lumen-based MCP (Model Context Protocol) server exposing Magento data to AI agents, integrating Claude Code CLI, GitHub, Postman, and Figma MCP into agentic development workflows — reducing manual development effort by 30% and cutting sprint delivery time by 20% across a team of 8+ developers.
- Leads Agile sprint planning, architecture reviews, and cross-timezone delivery for teams of 8+ developers across 3 time zones; mentors 5+ engineers.

- **Software Engineer** at BosLeo Pvt. Ltd. / Narola Infotech Pvt. Ltd, Valsad, India (Jan 2016 – May 2018) — delivered 10+ PHP/Laravel/CodeIgniter applications.
